name: Pixelarticons Component

description.zh: 看心形的像素转角，再按输出尺寸比较。 像素风界面图标入口，免费Base图稿与Pro图标集分别提供。官方免费包的Heart SVG及React生成脚本已实际读取，MIT要求保留版权与许可声明；Pro按独立购买及再分发条款使用，尚未安装包或付费购买。
description.en: A pixel art icon resource with free Base icons and separately purchased Pro sets. The official free package’s Heart SVG and React generator were read; its MIT license requires preserving copyright and permission notices. Pro use follows its own purchase and redistribution terms. No package installation or paid purchase was completed.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Pixelarticons (https://pixelarticons.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看心形的像素转角，再按输出尺寸比较。

Visual details from source observation: 我们在免费目录对照箭头、日历和电池的像素轮廓，再打开 Heart 看完整方格预览。建议按输出尺寸比较转角，当前面板停在 192px，其余只见选项，未逐一切换。免费包的 SVG 与 React 生成脚本已读取，使用须保留 MIT 版权和许可声明；Pro 按独立条款购买，不许原样再分发或转售图稿，库存数也不等于本次清点数。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
